_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/copies/test_enters_as_copy_except.py. t_eacx_duplicate is Dack's Duplicate: a 0/0 that may enter as a copy of any creature, except it has haste and dethrone. t_eacx_mirror is Cursed Mirror: a mana rock that may enter as a copy of any creature until end of turn, except it has haste. t_eacx_spark is Spark Double: a 0/0 that may enter as a copy of a creature or planeswalker you control, with an additional +1/+1 counter if it's a creature, an additional loyalty counter if it's a planeswalker, and not legendary. t_eacx_chameleon is Chameleon, Master of Disguise: a legendary 2/3 that may enter as a copy of a creature you control, except his name stays his own. t_eacx_metamorph is Phyrexian Metamorph: a 0/0 that may enter as a copy of any artifact or creature, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.

cards.name: Test Duplicate
cards.oracle_text: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has haste and dethrone.

cards.name: Test Mirror
cards.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {R}.
As this artifact enters, you may have it become a copy of any creature on the battlefield until end of turn, except it has haste.

cards.name: Test Spark Double
cards.oracle_text: You may have this creature enter as a copy of a creature or planeswalker you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature, it enters with an additional loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker, and it isn't legendary.

cards.name: Test Chameleon, Master of Disguise
cards.oracle_text: You may have Test Chameleon enter as a copy of a creature you control, except his name is Test Chameleon, Master of Disguise.

cards.name: Test Metamorph
cards.oracle_text: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any artifact or creature on the battlefield, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
